# Ask why they are leaving, then offer the one thing that might keep them

> Keep subscribers who only needed a nudge. A cancellation flow for Stripe that asks why, offers a pause or a discount matched to the reason, and reports your save rate. Preview it in the browser, then run the source-available server in your own account. Free, FSL-1.1-MIT.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
